search_text: published ZDI-21-779 ZDI-CAN-13039 (0Day) Advantech WebAccess Node BwFreRPT Stack-based Buffer Overflow Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2021-07-05 9.8 AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['Advantech'] ['WebAccess'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Advantech WebAccess Node. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within BwFreRPT.exe, which is accessed through the 0x2711 IOCTL in the webvrpcs process. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of the length of user-supplied data prior to copying it to a fixed-length stack-based buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the current user.
